items.title: Healey faces strict budget secrecy ahead of crucial fiscal test
items.summary: Chancellor John Healey has enforced intelligence-style security measures to keep the upcoming Budget secret, as BBC reporting highlights the balancing act between sustaining economic growth and reassuring nervous bond markets.

editorial_note: This hour's briefing links to previously approved complete reports; it does not claim a new development each hour. Original source dates remain visible. Older reporting is identified as background.
